title.narrative: ET-Road Sector Dev. Stage III Proj. (APL3) in support of Govt's RSDP

description.narrative: The objectives of road sector development project for Ethiopia are to assist the Government of Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia in (i) strengthening and increasing its road transport infrastructure and improving the reliability thereof; and (ii) strengthening the institutional capacity in quality and efficiency of road construction, management and maintenance; and creating conditions conducive for the domestic construction industry to develop in the road transport sector. The project consists of the following components: the upgrading and rehabilitation of federal trunk and link roads; construction of regional rural road; Institutional strengthening of Ethiopian Roads Authority through provision of technical assistance services to assure quality in procurement and safeguards aspects of program implementation and improve efficiency and effectiveness of roads program activities execution; technical assistance services to support accomplishment of program objectives.

The objectives of the Stage 3 of Adaptable Program Lending (APL3, or the project) are to assist the Recipient in (i) strengthening and increasing its road transport infrastructure and improving the reliability thereof; and (ii) strengthening the institutional capacity in quality and efficiency of road construction, management and maintenance; and creating conditions conducive for the domestic construction industry to develop in the road transport sector.
